aiAssistant.step1Desc: Identify 2 recurring tasks to hand over to junior associates with clear frameworks.
aiAssistant.step2Desc: Prefix all operational dashboards and slide decks with 1-page bottom-line conclusions.
aiAssistant.step3Desc: Host alignment sync with Product and Operations leads before mid-quarter review.
aiAssistant.aiTipsContent: Your recent project presentations showed high technical depth. Focusing on brief opening summaries will boost engagement with VP-level stakeholders.
aiAssistant.policySearchPlaceholder: Ask anything about company handbook, leaves, remote work, equipment...
aiAssistant.policyQ1: What is our remote work & flexible hours policy?
aiAssistant.policyA1: Employees in hybrid roles are eligible for up to 2 remote work days per week, subject to team coordination. Working hours remain flexible around core collaboration hours between 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM.
aiAssistant.policyQ2: How do sick leave submissions and medical certificates work?
aiAssistant.policyA2: Single-day sick leaves can be requested self-certified directly in the portal. Any sick leave exceeding 2 consecutive days requires an authorized medical report uploaded through the supporting documents field.
aiAssistant.policyQ3: What is the annual leave rollover allowance for 2026?
aiAssistant.policyA3: Employees may carry over up to 5 days of unused annual leave into the next calendar year. Carried-over days must be utilized within the first quarter (by March 31).
aiAssistant.pillSickLeave: What is my sick leave balance?
aiAssistant.pillRemoteWork: What is the remote work policy?
aiAssistant.chatAnnualCarryoverQ: How many annual leave days can I carry over?
aiAssistant.chatAnnualCarryoverA: You can carry over up to 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year. Carryover requests should be submitted before December 15.
aiAssistant.chatRemoteWorkQ: What is the remote work policy?
aiAssistant.chatRemoteWorkA: Your policy answer is grounded in the Employee Handbook and your current employee record.
